# Frontend Frameworks Comparison & Selector (javascript-frontend/frontend-frameworks)

> Verified 2026 data for 15 frontend frameworks and meta-frameworks (React 19.3, Vue 3.5, Angular 22.2, Svelte 5.57, SolidJS 1.9, Next.js 16.4, Astro 7.4, Nuxt 4.6, SvelteKit 3.2), workload selector, 5-framework task tracker implementations, and MIT starter templates.

## Summary
Live GitHub and npm adoption data verified on 2026-11-16, workload-based framework scoring (`src/advisor.ts` and `framework_advisor.py`), identical Sprint Task Tracker implementations across React 19, Vue 3.5, Svelte 5, Angular 22, and SolidJS, plus minimal Vite and Astro starter templates.

## Verified 2026 Snapshot
- React 19.3.1 (`facebook/react`): 252,661 stars | 260.9M npm weekly downloads
- Vue 3.5.45 (`vuejs/core`): 55,029 stars (legacy `vuejs/vue`: 212,519) | 25.2M npm weekly downloads
- Angular 22.2.6 (`angular/angular`): 101,480 stars | 8.2M npm weekly downloads
- Svelte 5.57.3 (`sveltejs/svelte`): 88,785 stars | 9.8M npm weekly downloads
- SolidJS 1.9.19 (`solidjs/solid`): 36,273 stars | 11.7M npm weekly downloads
- Next.js 16.4.6 (`vercel/next.js`): 143,582 stars | 94.4M npm weekly downloads
- Astro 7.4.12 (`withastro/astro`): 63,986 stars | 12.0M npm weekly downloads
- Nuxt 4.6.4 (`nuxt/nuxt`): 61,078 stars | 3.4M npm weekly downloads

## Recommendations by Workload
- Interactive SaaS dashboard or AI workspace: Next.js, React, SvelteKit, or Vue
- SEO content site, docs, or landing page: Astro (zero-JS Islands)
- Enterprise multi-team platform: Angular 22 or React with TypeScript
- Embeddable widget or low-JS HTML: Preact, Lit, Alpine.js, or htmx

## CLI Usage
- TypeScript CLI (Node 22+): `node src/advisor.ts --use-case saas-dashboard --seo-critical`
- Python CLI (Python 3.9+): `python3 framework_advisor.py --compare react vue svelte angular`
- Export CSV: `node src/advisor.ts --export-csv > frameworks.csv`
